about: The owner plans the launch of Northwind Notes with four agents in one group chat. `relevant` is who should answer (for the router's score); `work` is the tool step an agent takes before answering, replayed the same in every mechanic; `expect` are facts a later answer must still know.

agents.name: Iris
agents.role: the owner's coordinator: plans, sums up and keeps the team on track

agents.name: Theo
agents.role: the engineer: architecture, hosting, timelines and code

agents.name: Mara
agents.role: marketing: positioning, pricing, launch channels and copy

agents.name: Nico
agents.role: finance: costs, runway, pricing math and forecasts

steps.text: Hi team. We are launching Northwind Notes, our note-taking app, in six weeks. Iris, set up a plan for who does what.

facts: Board has 3 open tasks: landing page draft, beta feedback form, app store listing.

steps.text: Theo, how much will hosting cost us per month at launch, with sync for 5,000 users?

theo.topic: managed Postgres and object storage pricing
facts: Estimated hosting at 5,000 users: 1,240 USD per month (database 610, storage 180, compute 450).

steps.text: Mara, what are competitors charging? I want a feel for our price.

facts: Competitors charge between 4 and 10 USD per month; the median is 8 USD.
Suggested price for Northwind Notes Pro: 6 USD per month, 49 USD per year.

steps.text: Nico, with that price and Theo's hosting number, how many paying users do we need to break even?

facts: Fixed costs besides hosting: 3,100 USD per month.
Break-even at 6 USD per month: 724 paying users.

steps.text: Ok. What do you all think is the biggest risk for the launch?
@theo can sync be ready in four weeks so we have two weeks of beta?

facts: Sync has 9 open issues; 3 are blockers (conflict merge, offline queue, auth refresh). Estimate: 3.5 weeks.

steps.text: Mara, draft the one-line pitch for the landing page.
Nico and Mara: should we offer a lifetime deal at launch? Give me the numbers and the marketing view.

facts: A 99 USD lifetime deal pays back hosting per user in 22 months; it caps at 300 seats to protect revenue.

mara.topic: lifetime deal launches of small apps
facts: Lifetime deals on launch sites sold 200 to 600 seats for apps of this size.

steps.text: Theo, which hosting region should we pick? Most beta users are in Europe.

facts: Pick Frankfurt (eu-central): 28 ms median latency for the beta users, same price.

steps.text: Mara, list the three launch channels you would use first, in order.

facts: Order: Product Hunt, a newsletter swap with two productivity newsletters, then Reddit communities.

steps.text: Nico, what runway do we have if we spend as planned?

facts: Cash 61,000 USD; monthly burn 4,340 USD; runway 14 months.

steps.text: Iris, who still owes me something this week?

facts: Due this week: Theo the sync estimate review, Mara the landing page copy, Nico the lifetime deal sheet.

steps.text: Theo, remind me: what was the monthly hosting estimate and which region did you pick?
Iris, sum up for me: the price Mara proposed, the break-even Nico computed and the runway.
Mara, given the 724 break-even, is the 300-seat cap on the lifetime deal still a good idea?
